mapper.insert: INSERT INTO unipet.users ( USER_ID, USER_PWD, USER_NAME, NICKNAME, PHONE, EMAIL, USER_ADDR, FULL_ADDR, ZIPCODE, ROLE, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{pwd}, #{userName}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{userAddr}, #{fullAddr}, #{zipcode}, 'USER', NOW() )
INSERT INTO unipet.store_user ( S_USER_ID, S_USER_PWD, CEO_NAME, BIZ_FILE_NAME, U_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{pwd}, #{userName}, #{bizFileName}, 'PND' )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_PWD AS pwd, USER_NAME AS userName, NICKNAME AS nickname, PHONE, EMAIL, USER_ADDR AS userAddr, FULL_ADDR AS fullAddr, ZIPCODE, ROLE FROM unipet.users WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT S_USER_ID AS userId, S_USER_PWD AS pwd, CEO_NAME AS userName, U_STATUS AS status, 'BIZ' AS role FROM unipet.store_user WHERE S_USER_ID = #{userId} AND U_STATUS NOT IN ('BAN', 'EXT')
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, PHONE FROM unipet.users WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND REPLACE(PHONE, '-', '') = REPLACE(#{phone}, '-', '')
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, NICKNAME AS nickname, EMAIL, SOCIALTYPE AS socialType, ROLE FROM unipet.users WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO unipet.users ( USER_ID, USER_PWD, USER_NAME, NICKNAME, EMAIL, SOCIALTYPE, ROLE, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{socialType}, 'USER', NOW() )
